title: Minimize XOR With Matching Set Bits
description: Given two positive integers `num1` and `num2`, find the positive integer `x` such that `x` has the exact same number of set bits (`1`-bits) as `num2`, and the value `x XOR num1` is minimized. Return `x`. (The optimal `x` is guaranteed to be unique.)
hints: To minimize `x ^ num1`, cancel out the highest set bits of `num1` first by placing `1`-bits of `x` at those same positions from MSB down to LSB.
If you still have leftover `1`-bits to place after matching all set bits of `num1`, place them in the lowest unset bit positions of `x` from LSB up.

examples.explanation: num2 = 5 (101) has 2 set bits. Matching num1 = 3 (11) gives x = 3 with XOR 0.
num2 = 12 (1100) has 2 set bits. Match bit 0 of num1 = 1 and place the remaining bit at position 1, giving x = 3 (11).
num2 = 7 (111) has 3 set bits. Match bits 4 and 3 of num1 = 25 (11001) and bit 0, giving x = 25.
